def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float)
    n, p = X.shape; ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]])
    def ll(M):
        b = np.zeros(M.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30); mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = M.T @ (M * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(M.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, M.T @ (y - mu)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        mu = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu)))
    def base(sel): return np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] for j in sel]) if sel else S
    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False)
    sel = []
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        M0 = base(sel); l0 = ll(M0); best, bj = -1, None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 for k in sel): continue
            g = 2 * (ll(np.column_stack([M0, X[:, j]])) - l0)
            if g > best: best, bj = g, j
        a = (0.1 if not sel else 0.02) / p
        if bj is None or stats.chi2.sf(best, 1) > a: break
        # cluster swap: among |r|>=0.6 members with LL near best, pick the one explaining cluster best
        cl = [k for k in range(p) if abs(R[bj, k]) >= 0.6 and k not in sel]
        lls = {k: ll(np.column_stack([M0, X[:, k]])) for k in cl}
        top = max(lls.values())
        cand = [k for k in cl if lls[k] >= top - 2]
        bj = max(cand, key=lambda k: np.sum(R[k, cl] ** 2))
        sel.append(bj)
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False; lf = ll(base(sel))
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [k for k in sel if k != j]
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (lf - ll(base(rest))), 1) > 0.01 / p:
                sel = rest; changed = True; break
    prods = []
    M0 = base(sel); l0 = ll(M0); mu0 = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-0))
    m = p * (p + 1) // 2; sc = []
    # score-test prescreen on all pairs and squares
    b0 = np.linalg.lstsq(M0, y, rcond=None)[0]
    r0 = y - np.clip(M0 @ b0, 0.01, 0.99)
    for a in range(p):
        for b in range(a, p):
            z = X[:, a] * X[:, b]; z = z - z.mean()
            sc.append(((r0 @ z) ** 2 / (z @ z + 1e-9), a, b))
    sc.sort(reverse=True)
    res = []
    for _, a, b in sc[:20]:
        Mb = np.column_stack([M0] + [X[:, k] for k in (a, b) if k not in sel])
        lb = ll(Mb); z = X[:, a] * X[:, b]
        g = 2 * (ll(np.column_stack([Mb, z])) - lb)
        if stats.chi2.sf(g, 1) < 0.01 / m: res.append((g, a, b))
    res.sort(reverse=True)
    used = set()
    for g, a, b in res:
        if len(prods) >= 2 or a in used or b in used: continue
        prods.append((a, b)); used |= {a, b}
    drivers = list(sel)
    for a, b in prods:
        for k in (a, b):
            if k not in drivers: drivers.append(k)
    drivers = drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    cols = sorted(set(sel) | used)
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
